previous.changeLog:
- shot result calculations reworked, now with an estimated penetration chance based on the game's own dispersion, distance and armour layers; armour info shows again in every supported crosshair view and in replays;
- added languahe files: Chinese, Czech, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese
- added: `{angle}`, `{distance}`, and `{penChance}` template tokens.
- settings option improved

fixed an issue that displayed an empty panel (more a little dot) without text in garage if garage panel was deactivated in settings
fixed an issue where the moe battle panel only displayed "TODO!" when moe layout #6 was selected. 🤭
new: option to setup an alternate battle panel that can be activated with ALT key (custom mode required!)
new: real time template HTML preview for better control (see screenshot)
new battle template tokens added:{itdmg}{tdmg}  - icon for track assist and value{ispdmg}{spdmg}  - icon for spot assist and value{istdmg}{stdmg} - icon for stun assist and value
{iassist}{vassist} - icon for current assist type and value
modified settings screen to use tabs to split setting sections into Garage, Battle, WNX, Color, General and also moved some settings from WNX to General section

current.changeLog:
- fix: keep draggable flash panels within the visible screen area, the garage panel also retains a safety margin at the top and bottom.
- fix: preserve the garage panel position when changing its anchor point, including changes made from the login screen before the garage UI is loaded.
- add: compatibility with upcoming World of Tanks 2.4.1 while retaining support for 2.4.0.
- add: {pema} token added for custom battle template preview
- dependancy libs updated
